title: Temporally-Grounded Language Generation: Towards Real-Time Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.11326v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown remarkable progress in offline tasks such as image captioning and video question answering. However, real-time interactive environments impose new demands on VLMs, requiring them to generate utterances that are not only semantically accurate but also temporally precise. We identify two core capabilities necessary for such settings---\textit{perceptual updating} and \textit{contingency awareness}---and propose a new benchmark task, \textbf{Temporally-Grounded Language Generation (TGLG)}, to evaluate them. TGLG requires models to generate utterances in response to streaming video such that both content and timing align with dynamic visual input. To support this benchmark, we curate evaluation datasets from sports broadcasting and egocentric human interaction domains, and introduce a new metric, \textbf{TRACE}, to evaluate TGLG by jointly measuring semantic similarity and temporal alignment

translated_title: 时间接地语言生成：迈向实时视觉-语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.11326v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在离线任务如图像描述和视频问答中展现了显著进展。然而，实时交互环境对VLMs提出了新要求，要求它们生成不仅语义准确而且时间精确的话语。我们识别了此类场景所需的两项核心能力——\textit{感知更新}和\textit{偶然性意识}——并提出一个新的基准任务，\textbf{时间接地语言生成（TGLG）}，以评估这些能力。TGLG要求模型响应流式视频生成话语，使内容和时间与动态视觉输入对齐。为支持该基准，我们从体育转播和以自我为中心的人类交互领域策划了评估数据集，并引入新指标\textbf{TRACE}，通过联合测量语义相似性和时间对齐来评估TGLG。
tldr: 本文提出时间接地语言生成（TGLG）基准任务及TRACE指标，旨在评估和推动视觉-语言模型在实时流式视频中生成语义准确且时间精确的话语的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Temporally-Grounded Language Generation (TGLG) benchmark and TRACE metric to evaluate and advance vision-language models' ability to generate semantically accurate and temporally precise utterances in real-time streaming video.
